node.title: F scale recursion: pullback points are plane points of the quotient instance
node.statement: P cap D_j^per(M) is linearly isomorphic to P' cap D'_{j/M} at scale n/M (an M-pullback ell = g(X^M) places g's coefficients at multiples of M — a linear embedding). Hence F(n) <= F_primitive(n) + sum over M | gcd(n,j) of F(n/M): the periodic branch recurses, bottoming out at checkable scales.
